net.canarymod

Class Translator

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.visualillusionsent.utils.LocaleHelper
      • net.canarymod.Translator

  • public class Translator
extends net.visualillusionsent.utils.LocaleHelper
    This class handles internationalization (aka i18n). It will look up translations from a given key to the language that is currently active.
    Author:
    Chris (damagefilter), Jason (darkdiplomat)
